name: dogfood-payment-bnpl-installment-app
description: Dogfood app v1.41-3 — a Klarna + Affirm + Afterpay style Buy-Now-Pay-Later orchestrator (installment plan creation + per-installment schedule + soft credit-check risk scoring + late fee collection + settle / default terminal states) that drives a BNPL-as-a-platform surface backed by @kiwa-lab/payment v0.5 bnpl semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_KLARNA_API_KEY + KIWA_AFFIRM_API_URL + KIWA_AFTERPAY_API_URL + KIWA_CREDIT_BUREAU_URL provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/payment @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
